newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Choil Paper sets rights, bonus issues.
newsitem.headline: Choil Paper sets rights, bonus issues.

text.p: South Korea's Choil Paper Manufacturing Co said on Friday it plans to offer an 8-for-100 rights issue in January and a 2-for-10 bonus issue in February to raise operating funds.
Choil's paid-in capital would rise to 10.8 billion won after the two issues from 8.2 billion, a company statement said.

Choil will issue 163,991 common shares for the rights and allocate 20 percent of them to its employees. The remaining amount will be offered to its shareholders registered as of December 31 for the rights, the statement said.
The rights offering would be made at a 20 percent discount to the base issue price per share, which would be announced later, the statement said.
Subscription was scheduled for January 29 and 30 with payment due on February 14, it said.
Choil also planned to issue another 360,820 common shares and distribute them to its shareholders on February 15, it said.
The company's shares closed Friday's session at 14,600 won, up 800 won on the day.
